title: custom:popup-card-pro
description: Any cards in a pop-up that opens when the address ends in its hash (a navigate action to "#kitchen"): a sheet from the bottom on a phone, dragged down to close, a dialog on a wide screen. Takes no room on the dashboard while closed.

hash.description: The address part that opens the pop-up: hash: kitchen opens on #kitchen (a navigate action with navigation_path: "#kitchen")

width.description: How wide the dialog is on a wide screen; a phone always shows a sheet across its width

height.description: How tall it opens: auto, as tall as its cards (on a phone the sheet can be dragged up to the full height); full, as tall as it may be

cards.description: The cards, in Home Assistant's section grid: each spans the columns its grid options ask for (a tile half the width)
